correctness.rationale: For every \(a>0\) all hypotheses of the nondegenerate Hopf theorem are verified: \(p_b(\lambda)=\lambda^3+\lambda^2+a\lambda+2a\sqrt b\); at \(b_0=1/4\) the roots are \(-1\) and a simple imaginary pair. The crossing derivative is \(a/(a+1)>0\). The full quadratic bilinear form and normalized eigenvectors give \(l_1=-\sqrt a(8a+1)/((a+1)(4a+1))<0\). The exact symbolic checker reconstructs the expression. Therefore orbital stability, parameter side and period limit follow for every fixed \(a>0\). The theorem is local; no numerical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The published Sprott parameter atlas identifies periodic regions numerically but does not analytically locate and classify the parameter-uniform birth of stable small cycles. This all-positive-a exact boundary and explicit sign-definite first Lyapunov coefficient settle a motivated local bifurcation question for a classical quadratic chaotic flow; stable-cycle existence cannot be obtained from stationary constraints or numerically colored maps. It gives a concrete rigorous anchor for continuation and parameter-region analysis without asserting global chaotic properties.
